summary: Keep the source task deferred and do not create, merge or exclude a production company. Direct SEC and CPUC records resolve the historical Funds I/II Lodi Gas Storage ownership and complete January 18, 2008 exit, but no post-2008 direct source maps ArcLight's separate Current/Power label to a current legal entity, country, assets, ownership fund or vehicle.
resolvedFormerBlockers: CPUC Decision 05-12-007 directly verifies that ArcLight Fund II's WHP Acquisition II acquired 50% of Lodi Holdings while ArcLight Fund I's WHP Acquisition held the other 50%.

The direct filed audited SEC exhibit verifies the WHP entities, the March 31, 2003 and December 15, 2005 entry dates, the Lodi Gas Storage operating business and Buckeye's acquisition of all member interests on January 18, 2008.
ArcLight's 2025 ESG report groups Lodi Holdings and Lodi Holdings II under Funds I/II and Strategic Gas, consistent with the verified historical chain.
Current CPUC filings verify a separate Brookfield/Rockpoint successor ownership chain and pending control transfer that is unrelated to ArcLight.
The DigitalBridge Q2 2026 Form 10-Q verifies that the announced ArcLight manager acquisition remained conditional and contains no Lodi-specific transfer.

identityResolution.boundary: The historical Fund II vehicle and operating chain are proven, but no direct post-2008 source establishes what legal entity, asset or investment ArcLight currently means by its separate Lodi Holdings II / Power / Current row. The live label cannot be assumed to be the realized vehicle, the Brookfield/Rockpoint successor, BGH Holdings, Lodi Energy Center, Kirby Hills II or a Lodi solar project.

applicationRequirements: Keep this member terminal-only as DEFERRED; do not generate a database or seed after-image.
Do not create a current Lodi Holdings II company from the unexplained ArcLight Current/Power row.

Do not merge the label into Lodi Gas Storage, the Brookfield/Rockpoint successor chain, BGH Holdings, Lodi Energy Center, Kirby Hills II or Lodi solar projects without direct same-company and current-ownership evidence.
Do not convert the historical Funds I/II ownership into a current ownership period; it ended on January 18, 2008.
Preserve the DigitalBridge-ArcLight transaction as conditional manager-level context and the Rockpoint transaction as a separate successor-chain pending transaction.
